required_transformations: Aggregate user-level data to daily signup counts by city tier
Calculate conversion rates by acquisition channel using converted_flag
Compute 7-day retention rates by cohort week using retained_7d_flag
Aggregate raw user data to create derived KPI flags instead of exporting raw timestamps
justification: Aggregate outputs fully answer all three business questions without raw user-level export
Minimization principle: internal query uses only 6 fields needed for aggregate computations
Password hash and auth_token are credential material that must never be released
Derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) replace raw behavior timestamps as per policy
